note: San Bernardino NF campground near Rimforest, five minutes from Lake Arrowhead, in cedar, oak and pine beside Rim of the World High School. Mostly tent sites; the RV sites have paved but narrow aprons. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends. --Claude
summary: Dogwood (San Bernardino NF): rec.gov 232037 and FS page agree; $40-51 confirmed, extra vehicle $8; 87 sites (stored 92), 18 electric (13 x 30 A, 5 x 50 A) all reservable, max 55 ft; flush toilets, showers, water, dump ($10); season mid-Apr to late Oct; reservation only (no FCFS), max 14. Pin ~275 m W of the site centroid. Phone 909-382-2600 -> (909) 866-8550. Not waterfront confirmed.
